BiblicalUsage: Sheal appears once, in a list of the sons of Bani who had taken foreign wives and put them away in the days of Ezra. His name means asking, and his story is told in one line: he is named among those who turned back.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single line in a list can still preach. Sheal is remembered because he obeyed when obedience cost him, and that is how most faithfulness looks.
